title: A Ghost for the Contact
author: Hazel Blackwood
blurb: Casper Oyelaran, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
